source.role: sole project-owned Infernal visual direction and image-generation reference

albedoCreation.operation: generated original derived candidate, then deterministically resized to 1024x1024 PNG with sips -z 1024 1024
albedoCreation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 1024-square RGB tileable Infernal courtyard-floor albedo candidate for a mobile fantasy game.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole visual source/reference for the project-owned Infernal charcoal-and-ember direction.
Primary request: derive a distinct forged Infernal courtyard floor from the reference: broad cooled basalt and ash slabs, sparse subdued ember fissures, calm enough behind characters, and visually distinct from a route or boundary.
Scene/backdrop: exact orthographic top-down full square ground surface only.
Style/medium: clean stylized mobile-game albedo; broad low-frequency forms; no photographic micro-noise.
Composition/framing: distribute interlocking broad slabs evenly across the whole square; balance all outer edges to suggest repeat continuity; no central emblem, radial design, directional flow, or focal slab.
Lighting/mood: flat diffuse albedo only; no directional light, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, bloom, glow, or baked depth.
Color palette: charcoal black and graphite basalt with restrained, sparse deep ember orange-red in fine fissures.
Materials/textures: matte cooled volcanic stone with subtle ash variation; fissures must be thin and controlled.
Constraints: no props, characters, structures, gates, weapons, lava pools, roots, UI, labels, text, watermarks, logos, symbols, normal-map colors, or third-party visual motifs. Keep it as a ground-color albedo candidate only, not a runtime claim.

normalCreation.algorithm: wrapped-edge luminance central differences encoded as normalized RGB tangent-space normals

repeatEvidence.albedoCommand: PYTHONPATH=Tools/surface_maps python3 -c 'from derive_normal_map import read_png, repeat_grid, write_rgb_png; p="ArtPreviews/MWS11-InfernalCourtyardFloor/infernal-courtyard-floor-albedo-rgb-candidate.png"; w,h,rgb=read_png(p); gw,gh,grid=repeat_grid(w,h,rgb); write_rgb_png("ArtPreviews/MWS11-InfernalCourtyardFloor/infernal-courtyard-floor-albedo-2x2-repeat-evidence.png",gw,gh,grid)'
repeatEvidence.result: The exact 2x2 grid shows no hard center-cross or outer-edge seam; repeating broad slab shapes and ember fissures remain visible periodicity and require material-scale/on-device review.

reviewRequired: material scale and sRGB/linear import validation
on-device lighting, readability behind characters, and periodicity review
nonGoals: emission, height, roughness, or metallic maps
